gates.py:388 `def quality_check_cli(argv: list[str], tracker: str) -> int:` (2-arg)
gates.py:211 `def clarity_check_cli(argv: list[str], tracker: str, repo_root: str | None) -> int:` (3-arg)
_execute.py:122 argv_tracker_root calls `fn(rest, tracker, None)` — a 3-arg call
